|champion     = Garen
|skill        = E 
|icon         = Judgment.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Garen}} rapidly spins with his sword for a short time while {{tip|ghosted}}, continually dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. He spins more based on his {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
|blurb2       = The nearest enemy is dealt increased damage. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit by enough spins will have {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|reduced armor}}}}.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} ''Judgment'' is ended early.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' rapidly spins his sword around himself {{#var:spin_b}} (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|{{#var:spin_as}}% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Only bonus attack speed from item stats and growth (per level)}}) times over 3 seconds, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies {{tt|periodically|Spin rate is 3 ÷ number of spins}}. ''Judgment'' can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}} to {{#var:ad5}}}}% AD)}}|Critical Strike Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+{{#var:crit}}) to 16*(1+{{#var:crit}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*(1+{{#var:crit}}) to {{#var:ad5}}*(1+{{#var:crit}})}}% AD)}}|{{ii|Infinity Edge|IE}} Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}}) to 16*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}}) to {{#var:ad5}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}})}}% AD)}}}}
|description2 = Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.
|icon3        = Judgment 3.png
|description3 = ''Judgment'' deals {{ap|({{#var:near}}-1)*100}}% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit. 
|leveling3    = {{st|Increased Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*{{#var:near}} to 16*{{#var:near}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:near}} to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:near}}}}% AD)}}|Increased Critical Strike Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}}) to 16*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}}) to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:crit}})}}% AD)}}|Increased {{ii|Infinity Edge|IE}} Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}}) to 16*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad1}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}}) to {{#var:ad5}}*{{#var:near}}*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+{{#var:crit}})}}% AD)}}}}
|icon4        = Judgment 2.png
|description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Garen''' ends ''Judgment''.
|description5 = ''Judgment'' can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{#expr:100+{{#var:crit}}*100}}|{{#expr:{{#var:crit}}*100}}}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|{{#expr:{{#var:crit}}*100}}% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|9 to 6}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 325
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time    = none
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = false
|spelleffects = aoedot
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* At level 20, '''Garen''' will spin a minimum of {{ap|{{#var:spin_b}}+{{#expr:floor(({{ccd|Garen|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1)))/{{#var:spin_as}})}}}} times.
* Deactivating the ability manually does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Each spin triggers a stack of {{ri|Conqueror}}.
* For the purpose of moving closer to an enemy when right clicking them, ''Judgment'' also reduces '''Garen's''' {{sti|attack range|link=range}} {{ft|to 100|by 75}} for the duration.
* ''Judgment'' only scales with {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} from items and growth (per level).
* ''Judgment'' cancels '''Garen's''' last movement command upon ending.
* Each spin deals damage simultaneously to all enemies within its range when the spin is completed.
* The spin animation is capped at {{as|{{tt|200%|Once per 0.2 seconds, 15 spins total}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}, but the amount of ticks will keep on scaling.
* The armor reduction stacks multiplicatively with other percentage armor penetration effects.
{{ct|attack=false|cast={{ai|Decisive Strike|Garen}} and {{ai|Courage|Garen}} are usable. {{ai|Demacian Justice|Garen}} interrupts.|move=true|items=true|consume=true|spells=true,true,true,false,true|interrupts=death}}
